articles.title: NVIDIA contributes Vera Rubin rack designs to open AI infrastructure standards
articles.summary: The OCP Summit package pairs hardware designs with facility specifications and open-source operating tools. Its grid standard sets a recovery target, not a measured result.

articles.title: AMD introduces an AI-agent rack design with up to 32,768 CPU cores
articles.summary: Helion offers separate agent-execution capacity or an integrated CPU/GPU system. AMD targets November availability, but independent coverage gives a later schedule.

articles.title: AWS releases an AI-agent sandbox that checks actions against what happened before
articles.summary: Strands Box combines operating-system isolation with history-aware rules. The free developer preview runs on Apple silicon Macs, but directly granted files bypass its policy history.

articles.title: TII Releases Falcon-ASR: 1.6B Arabic Speech Model Hits 20.92% WER
articles.summary: TII has released Falcon-ASR, a 1.6B speech recognition model for Arabic with an Emirati focus. It reports 20.92% average WER on 6 Arabic test sets, but weights and an API are not yet available. The post TII Releases Falcon-ASR: 1.6B Arabic Speech Model Hits 20.92% WER appeared first on MarkTechPost .
